select count(1) from video_comment v
inner join pilipili.video_info vi on v.video_id = vi.video_id

select v.*, u.user_name userName, u.avatar, u2.user_name replyUserName, u2.avatar replyAvatar from video_comment v inner join pilipili.user u on v.user_id = u.user_id left join pilipili.user u2 on v.user_id = u2.user_id where p_comment_id = #{commentId} order by v.comment_id
mapper.insert: insert into pilipili.video_comment(p_comment_id, video_id, video_user_id, content, img_path, user_id, reply_user_id, post_time) values (#{pCommentId}, #{videoId}, #{videoUserId}, #{content}, #{imgPath}, #{userId}, #{replyUserId}, #{postTime});
